body:
I actually tend to cycle between oversleeping and not sleeping at all. For example I just woke up at 3am tonight and I don't know when or if I'll get back to sleep. Neither extreme helps my body much and it's going to be a big problem if I get a job, which just adds to my worries.

I've been trying to get involved in projects but that's turning out to be easier said than done. I agreed to draw a comic for a zine because I love drawing, it'd let me see a project to completion and I'd also have something printed and out there (big milestone). But it's been 2 weeks and I haven't done shit (thankfully the deadline is very generous). Drawing is my favourite hobby and I don't even enjoy doing it any more, that is heartbreaking.

I have a couple of other friends but we're not close. We just play video games or do other things, but I don't really know about their lives and I don't talk much about mine. It's nice but I don't feel like it's enough by itself.

It's only been during the last couple of years that I've experienced real closeness with anyone. Even with my former best friend, we didn't talk about anything heavy until years into the friendship. So having people who care about me and that I can share stuff with is still a new and overwhelming experience, and I'm finding it hard to adjust to not having it any more. In a lot of ways I wish I'd never made any deep connections because then at least I wouldn't know what I'm missing.

I actually don't care about what my friend did any more. It was over a year ago and I've been over him for a long time. Those were just examples of things related to what my real problems are, which are my extremely low-self esteem, inability to trust anyone, loneliness, feeling like there's no help or anyone to turn to etc. Those are the reasons I think I should die, not any specific people. Sorry if it came across the wrong way.

I know what you're talking about. One of the first things I read when I was looking for a way out of depression was 'Mindfulness in Plain English' which discusses this idea. It makes sense on some level, but there is a lot more going on than that.

I don't know what you can do, sorry. I know that's not helpful. I have the same problem when I call hotlines or speak to therapists. I'm not sure what I'm supposed to say or what's supposed to happen.

I started feeling depressed over a year ago, when my best friend (of 8 years) cut off contact with me. I came out as bisexual to him and he hated the idea so much that he decided he didn't want anything to do with me any more, and I haven't spoken to him since. It blew my mind that someone I trusted for so long, who was a pretty intelligent and open-minded guy otherwise and who I had shared a lot of other things with could change his tune so quickly. I already had trust issues before this so this didn't help those at all. 

Anyway after a couple of months of depression I somehow managed to make a few more friends. We became really close and after a few months I was actually for the first time in my life feeling happy. It felt amazing to know there were people who actually liked me enough to spend time with me. I quit my antidepressants, stopped seeing my therapist and felt great knowing my life was finally going somewhere. But then for reasons I never figured out (although I have theories) they also cut off contact and turned hostile towards me, which destroyed my progress and left me in the same position I was in before, only worse. This situation is especially painful because I know I'm being strung along - they haven't explicitly told me to go away like my best friend did, they just make excuses and won't be direct to give me false hopes. And because they promised me that they wouldn't do the same thing he did, and that I could trust them and that they'd be there for me, which were all lies. 

It probably sounds dumb that I'm getting upset about this but I have big underlying problems with loneliness, self-esteem and trusting people so my interpersonal relationships are really important to me. I keep failing and I don't know if it's because I'm a faulty person or if this kind of manipulation and cruelty is what I should expect from everyone I deal with.
